values.description: Local backend (npm run dev). For staging, replace with the staging API base ending in /api/v1, no trailing slash. Never the production URL.
Non-production ERP key id, configured in the local/staging backend ERP_API_KEYS only (never a production key id)
Secret of that non-production key (32+ characters). Current value only; never commit, export or share.
Variant SKU on the local/staging database used by Item Add, Item Edit, Stock Update and Item Lookup
Existing category name in the local/staging database, for Item Add
24-hex order id from the local/staging database (copy from Order Checking)
Tracking number sent with the status change
Leave empty to auto-generate a unique id per send; set a fixed value to test redelivery
SHA-256 (hex) of the file selected in Image Upload
